Copied verbatim from `serverchief/protocol/agent/v1/fixtures/` (Server Chief agent protocol v1, revision 1.1.0, fixtures as of serverchief commit a9a3a292, which added the heartbeat's `capabilities` and `update-agent-result-request.json` for agent self-updates; 44adebaf added commands, the `packages` and `updates` datasets and `cache_updated_at`), so the agent's tests do not depend on the sibling repository. Re-copy them when the spec changes. `inventory-certificates-request.json` (the `certificates` dataset and the vhosts `certificate.fingerprint` link) is copied from the backend working tree of 2026-10-24, before it was committed. `inventory-repositories-request.json` (the `repositories` dataset and the packages' `origins`) is copied from the backend working tree of 2026-10-24, before it was committed. `config-response.json`, `enroll-response.json` (the `metrics` configuration) and `heartbeat-request.json` (`capabilities.metrics`) are copied from the backend working tree of 2026-10-25, before it was committed. `inventory-vhosts-request.json` and `inventory-certificates-request.json` (the vhosts `redirect` and `https_redirect` fields) are copied from the backend working tree of 2026-10-26, before it was committed. `heartbeat-request.json` (`capabilities.reboot`, `capabilities.disabled` and the `reboot` helper action), `commands-response.json` (a `reboot` command), `reboot-result-request.json` (the `reboot` result with `output`), `enroll-request.json` and `enroll-response.json` (`protocol_revision` 1.2.0) are copied from the backend working tree of 2026-11-03 (revision 1.2.0), before it was committed. `commands-response.json` (an `upgrade_packages` command) and `upgrade-packages-result-request.json` (the `upgrade_packages` result) are copied from the backend working tree of 2026-11-03 (revision 1.2.0, *Package updates*), before it was committed.
